    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])  # set for quick membership
    id_to_node = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}

    # sort nodes by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    retained = set(n['id'] for n in nodes)
    removed = []

        nid = node['id']
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        if not node['removable']:

        if node['parent'] is None:  # root
            continue
        if node['symbol'] in required_symbols:

        # check if any child is still retained

            symbols_present.add(id_to_node[rid]['symbol'])
        if all(sym in symbols_present for sym in required_symbols):
            retained = temp_retained
            removed.append(nid)
    retained_ids = sorted(retained)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed, "retained_node_ids": retained_ids}
